name: codex-threadctl
description: Codex skill for inspecting and controlling app-server-backed threads.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and control app-server-backed Codex threads.
interface.longDescription: Codex Threadctl provides guidance for inspecting thread activity, context and compaction state, retrieving messages, interrupting active turns, and compacting idle threads.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-threadctl to inspect a Codex thread and choose a safe lifecycle action.
